name: Artillery Team [Combat, Selfish, Teamwork]
body:
Together, you and an ally can operate an oversized and unwieldy weapon.

Prerequisite(s): Proficiency with light crossbow, heavy crossbow, or musket; size Small or Medium.

Benefit(s): When you’re adjacent to an ally, you both count as being Large for the purpose of using Large light crossbows, Large heavy crossbows, and Large muskets. Firing such a weapon this way requires you or your ally to support the barrel or bow of the weapon. You must be able to trace a line from the firer’s space to the target’s space in such a way that the line passes through the space of the ally that is not firing the weapon. The ally doesn’t provide soft cover to the target. The ally not firing uses her actions to load the weapon, and the firer uses their actions to make attacks. The supporter holding the weapon applies all feats and abilities to reloading, while the firer applies all feats and abilities to making attacks. This feat does not allow you and your ally to act simultaneously on the same initiative.
